title: MaterialClassification
description:
MaterialClassification: Represents a generic material by its category, type, grade, and constituent. This classification can be used to identify and group materials for various purposes, such as material selection, specification, and analysis.
The classification can be put on a phsyical Material as a IMaterialProeprties or on a MaterialFragment as a IFragment.

Category.description: The category of the material, e.g., 'Concrete', 'Steel', 'Wood', etc.

Type.description: The type of the material, e.g., 'Reinforced', 'Prestressed', etc.

Grade.description: The grade of the material, e.g., 'C30/37', 'S420', 'F175', etc.

Constituent.description: The constituent of the material, e.g., Fly Ash, GGBS, etc.

_bhomVersion.description: Optional version of BHoM used as part of automatic versioning and schema upgrades.
